_about: Owner: writer of batch B3a (concepts/engine-step-loop, concepts/request-lifecycle, concepts/scheduler, code/scheduler-hpp, code/sequence-hpp, code/sequence).

attempt-point.short: A step in which the scheduler may start a prefill. With the defaults, every 70th decode step (ALL point) and every 100th decode step (ANY point). The step right after a prefill step (decode_step 0) is also an ALL point.
attempt-point.long: ALL point: decode_step % prefill_attempt_interval == 0. ANY point: decode_step != 0 and decode_step % prefill_any_attempt_interval == 0 ({{cite csrc/engine/scheduler.hpp:308-309}}).

token-budget.short: max_num_batched_tokens: the largest number of query tokens in one engine step. A prefill batch stops, or cuts a prompt into a chunk, at this limit.

cache-watermark.short: The scheduler starts a new prefill only if 90 % or less of the KV blocks are in use. This keeps free blocks for the decode steps.

recompute.short: One way to handle preemption. The sequence keeps its tokens but loses its KV blocks, goes to the front of the waiting queue, and runs a new prefill later.

finish-reason.short: The text that tells why a request ended: stop, length, abort, prompt_length_exceeded, insufficient_system_resource, ve_error, or a grammar error.
finish-reason.long: Made by get_finished_reason from the sequence status ({{cite csrc/engine/sequence.hpp:45-64}}).

request-output.short: The C++ object for one new token of one request: the token id, its log-probability, the finished flag and the finish reason. step() returns handles to these objects.

schedulable.short: A flag on each sequence. The scheduler does not start the prefill of a sequence until the flag is true. Requests with multimodal data wait for the image worker.
schedulable.long: Set to multi_modal_data is None at creation ({{cite csrc/engine/pybind_sequence.cpp:35}}) and to true by Scheduler::set_schedulable ({{cite csrc/engine/scheduler.hpp:1054-1059}}).

sequence-metadata.short: A per-step view of one scheduled sequence: how many query tokens it sends (seqlen_q), how many tokens attention reads in this step (seqlen_k), its block table and sampling values.

scheduler-outputs.short: The result of one schedule() call: the scheduled sequences, prefill or decode, the query tokens per sequence, and the finished and ignored sequences.

placeholder-step.short: An engine step with no real sequence. The worker runs the model on one dummy sequence, so that all data-parallel ranks keep the same order of collective calls.
